query:
SELECT 
  e.nome AS escola,
  e.inep,
  e.municipio,
  t.nome AS tecnico,
  os.qtdApInstalado AS aps,
  DATE_FORMAT(os.dataConclusao, '%d/%m/%Y') AS data_conclusao,
  COALESCE(os.observacao, '') AS observacao
FROM ordens_servico os
JOIN escolas e ON e.id = os.escolaId
JOIN tecnicos t ON t.id = os.tecnicoId
WHERE os.status = 'concluida'
  AND (e.municipio LIKE '%Monte Santo%' OR e.municipio LIKE '%monte santo%')
ORDER BY e.nome ASC;
